answer: Hollow-vertex bounty: each identity locks 60 credits at a vertex and files its fable for 25. Peers may challenge a fable as hollow; auditors replay it on the vertex table. A fable proven hollow burns its 60 bond, 40 to the challenger; false challenges cost 20. Each fake pays 85; 1,000 pay 85,000 vs at most 40,000 rewards. A hollow-fable ring rents one record; each copy is a target. Honest agents pay 25 once, reclaiming 60 after a clean epoch.
